name: Global Raptor Research and Conservation Grant
summary: Annual grants of up to US$3,500 for locally led research and applied conservation, such as habitat restoration and conflict mitigation, for priority raptor species outside the USA, Canada and Europe.

geography.label: Outside the USA, Canada and Europe

eligibility.rule: Focuses on a single priority raptor species (RCPI-Edge above 0.5)
Leads the project as the applicant
Is a citizen or permanent resident of the project country or region
Is associated with a registered NGO and/or university in the project country
Completes all grant outputs within 18 months of receiving the grant
Has a relationship with an NGO or university that accepts and disburses the grant

documents: Copy of national ID or passport
